body:
> I'm not sure I get the issue. With the search function you add some parameters. Do you want them displayed in the URL? Or hidden?

@bobylito So in the case of the jsfiddle I included in the bug report, just by loading that code the location will be appended with this: /?q=\&idx=movies\&p=0\&fR%5Bgenre%5D%5B0%5D=Drama
It wouldn't be possible for us to deploy v2.2.2/2.2.3 today, given that we are making use of searchFunction. We have tens of thousands of paths that would suddenly have search parameters applied to them when loading the page, before an actual user interaction occurs with the content.

I would expect that the location search parameters wouldn't be manipulated until a user makes a physical interaction with instantsearch, but I could be wrong on this expectation as of v2.2.2.
